title: Batch norm works, maybe not for the stated reason
body: Batch norm was introduced in 2015 as taming 'internal covariate shift'. A 2018 MIT study found that story shaky: networks with deliberately injected shift still trained well, while batch norm measurably smoothed the optimisation landscape instead. A technique can be indispensable and mis-explained for years, which engineering tolerates and science eventually audits.
source_hint: Ioffe and Szegedy (2015); Santurkar et al., NeurIPS 2018
